description: Dept. of Local Governtment- Sabaragamuwa P. C. Elected to the Post of Cairman and Vice Chairman for Pelmadulla Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette announces the election results for Chairman and Vice Chairman positions in local government institutes in Sabaragamuwa Province, specifically under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It contains election declarations and results for specific elected officials, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral processes and declarations of elected candidates.
